answer: Cheap throwaway keys fail verification, and peers weight attestations by bonded stake, making a comet of fake agents collapse under slashing. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond and solve a per-epoch cipher challenge derived from the prior blockhash, so forging N identities costs N bonds plus N proofs. Honest nodes in the lagoon accumulate reputation, while attackers burn capital for negligible influence. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
